revision_reason: The first hosted Linux matrix timed out with a blank rendered screen while the same pinned binary produced visible output in a native PTY. The v2 specs make the clean Git and noninteractive terminal environment explicit under the runner public environment allowlist. All v1 attempts remain preserved.
